car.name: Cleavers 1997
car.description: A formal midnight-blue V12 saloon restored for 2994, with a long wheelbase, soft suspension and effortless four-speed rear drive.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: April 1997 Japan Toyota Century standard column-shift E-GZG50-AESGK, 4996cc 1GZ-FE V12, RWD four-speed automatic, RHD, standard 16-inch wheels and solid roof. Not dual EMV package, later six-speed, CNG, hybrid, Century Royal or modified VIP car.
